summary: Residential kerb with homes 4 to 15 m away and no parked cars.
reasons: Homes within 10 m for much of it
No cars park here; van would stand out
No-stopping and bus zone signs along it

best_section.where: Hawken Drive south kerb, between the first houses and Nivani Court

drivers.seclusion: Homes 7 m behind and 10 m ahead; nearest apartments at 9 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerbside lane with tree-lined verge; room to stop but no cars parked.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road with bus zones.
drivers.convention: No parking convention seen; Mon-Fri 7am-7pm no-parking and no-stopping signs.

sun_shade: Street trees shade the kerb from the south; open to the north.
